name: Elespad
description: The Elespads were a pachydermoid, sentient species. They had brown or orange skin color, two large and floppy ears, a trunk and a pair of tusks. Luke Skywalker, a young Tatooinian farmer, encountered several hostile Elespads while looking for his droid R2-D2, who had been stolen by a changeling named Sasori Vader.
